posts.message:
Three new Eagles in Troop 77!  
Adam A in late August, and Brent B and Brian P this week!

Congratulations to all of you!

Oct 2026 - Hidden Lake Aviation Campout.   We were supposed to fly with EAA, but Hurricane Isaias out in the gulf had other plans for us.  We still camped, but the rain bands and wind potential made flying not possible.  We ended up getting very little rain or wind, but most of the rain just missed us.    

We still did the Aviation Merit Badge, and will fly a different day.
Sept 2026 - Manatee Springs Campout.  Canoeing, Kayaking, Snorkeling, Campfire Program, Flag Retirement - It was a full weekend of fun in absolutley wonderfull weather.

Sept 2026 - Work on Anthony's Eagle project Bat Houses. These started at the August campout cutting the pieces and staining. Today they were constructed, and placed out in the preserve.  These are large custom fully constructed bathouses, not prebuilt ones.
